concerns.text: T008's verification requires performance.json to validate against the ENTIRE model_performance.schema.yaml 'including ... feature_importances', but feature_importances are produced only by T009, which is ordered after and depends on T008. As ordered, T008's full-schema check can never pass — a consumer-before-producer violation on the artifact. Scope T008's verification to the sections it emits (test_metrics, bootstrap_ci, paired_ttest) or move importance extraction into T008.

T001 is tagged [P] and listed as parallel with T002–T006, yet its verification requires 'python -m code.src.pipeline.run' to exit 0 with 'Pipeline completed successfully' — an end-to-end run that consumes download, featurize, and pipeline stages implemented by T002–T009. The [P] tag is unsafe and the verification is unachievable until downstream tasks complete; T001's executable check must be deferred to T010 or its verification scoped to a unit test of the entry-point wiring.

T009's fallback says to 'append them to features.csv' and re-run T007–T009, but T006 (split) is not re-run even though the augmented matrix changes the row set the split was drawn from; the re-run chain should explicitly include re-splitting (or state that the existing split is reused by row identity) to keep the producer→consumer chain for train.csv/test.csv coherent.
